items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I went to hear them one night in Omaha while I was with Nat.

ctx.x: Did you like the way Benny's band played then?

Yeah, I loved his band. Yeah, he has good players. I dug his band, yeah. I always did. And you know, I went to hear them one night in Omaha while I was with Nat. I -- Toles' band was out of town. I had been sick. I got up out of my sick bed and went and got me a taxi and went down there. It was cold in Omaha, Nebraska, and the doctor -- you know, I had a light touch of pneumonia, but I got up, because they played there with Krupa, Hamp, Vido, you know, his regular band. And I got up, man, and got me a taxi, man,…
